canonical_statement: For Borel probability measures mu and nu on the real line, equality of their characteristic functions at every real argument implies mu = nu.
domain_and_universes: mu nu : Measure Real with Real's Borel measurable-space instance; proposition in Prop
conclusion: mu = nu as Borel measures on Real

checked_alternate_forms.integrand: fun x : Real => Complex.exp (t * x * Complex.I)

excluded_substitutions: a density or moment restricted uniqueness theorem
a random-variable theorem without a checked pushforward transport
degenerate_cases: All probability measures are included, including dirac 0 and other atomic laws.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory with mathlib measure, integration, complex exponential, and characteristic-function infrastructure; no custom axiom declarations
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib revision 8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95
computation_profile: noncomputable measure-theoretic proposition; no computation or oracle supplies proof credit

distinguished: changed the domain from Real to Complex and the API to charFunDual
restricted the characteristic-function equality binder to nonnegative frequencies
excluded the boundary case of the Dirac measure at zero

status_boundary: This artifact freezes and elaborates the exact measure-level target and a checked integral encoding only. It supplies no proof, anchor acceptance, H0 source verdict, audit completion, or theorem-completion evidence.
